chapter: Carnegie Hall and the touring years
title: Back in New York on Fifty-Second Street with Basie and Rushing
summary: He sang with Basie in a small club, got a job there with Rushing for four or five years, then went to California.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So I went back to New York and started t' workin' in the night-clubs around in New York, 'cause ever'body know me there. Wasn't no trouble to get a gig. So I worked on Fifty-Second Street. I used to go down there to see Count Basie workin' in a little, small joint. So I got up an' sang a couple o' songs wit' him. So the man give me a job. An' they had Jimmy Rushing, me, Count Basie's band. So, I work around there for four...five years, an' then I took off and come back to California. I took off and run back to California again.
